$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: why the console asks for each device it declares (namespace `devices::`, `<device>.reason`): shown in the operating system's permission prompt and written by gen into the macOS usage strings (NSCameraUsageDescription and friends); Boundary: one entry per device desktop.config.ts declares; gen fails on a declared device without a reason in any locale; Runtime: node; Governing contract: ADR 0251 (desktop hardening), ADR 0253 (peripherals), ADR 0080

camera.reason: Acme Console uses the camera to scan product barcodes and to photograph products for the catalogue.

microphone.reason: Acme Console uses the microphone when you dictate a request to the command palette.

usb.reason: Acme Console uses USB to reach the receipt printer, the cash drawer and wired barcode scanners.

bluetooth.reason: Acme Console uses Bluetooth to pair wireless barcode scanners and receipt printers.

serial.reason: Acme Console uses the serial port to read weighing scales and drive customer displays.
